stem: Which sentence best expresses a theme in the story?

options.label: A
options.text: "Often, when people look better, they act better too." (paragraph 5)

options.label: B
options.text: A visit to the fabric store that weekend turned into an expedition as he hunted down the perfect textiles for his creation. (paragraph 10)

options.label: C
options.text: On his way back home, he looked at what people were wearing, the parade of pants, shirts, dresses, jeans, and ordinariness. (paragraph 11)

options.label: D
options.text: "Not everyone is going to see things the way you do—not right away, and maybe not ever." (paragraph 18)
